SELECT r.id, r.room_number, r.building_id, b.campus_id
FROM dorm_room r
LEFT JOIN dorm_building b ON r.building_id = b.id
WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT
r.id AS room_id,
r.room_number,
b.id AS building_id,
b.building_name,
b.campus_id,
c.campus_name
FROM dorm_room r
LEFT JOIN dorm_building b ON r.building_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN sys_campus c ON b.campus_id = c.id
WHERE r.id = #{id}
